test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

MAID - DAMI - AIMD

FOUR - ROFU - OUFR
solution:
The logic followed here is:

For, MAID → DAMI → AIMD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec53786b1aca062f504c120c3729cfbbb4d1c40d87ab6db25e00a4edd2bc93f2.png] 

For, FOUR → ROFU → OUFR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20a05e363fbd680e6ab4ed1da75a74f6e9aa24f3396a222ff9040a63d79716af.png] 

Now, check the options using the same pattern:

Option 1) WENT → TEWN → NEWT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57da9d68c528c688550377cd444e9134602332c443394145c112562d526e7a57.png] 

Option 2) GOLD → OGLD → DOLG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0ba318aa27dcf7e707098fb13d3999313fc71295568ac76dc9af6b29666355.png] 

Option 3) HUNT → TUHN → UNHT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b3a8fc4fadc6d2ba0f76cee804723bd2890a7cc48e72c3f12ec60df10bd2d8d.png] 

Option 4) LOAD → LAOD → DAOL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/162216fc7b56a086b1a8c89651d1be0b6c1b660d38aff4f24fa28de343cae883.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
